summary: Conservative reconciliation of the two validated math_and_collision proposals into one engine map. Output: 1 engine subsystem, 8 canonical type families, 0 state machines, 2 interfaces, 18 function-level dependencies, and 7 compatibility contracts. One evidence-grounded consolidation: 0x004038E0 (nearest-strut query) is assigned to CollisionModel because it reads the same +0x130/+0x134 316-byte-stride element array that CollisionModel owns and tears down (0x004045F0); the node-chain/tree walkers 0x004039C0/0x00403AA0 stay in SpatialNearestNeighborQuery. The wave_001_math_and_collision_01:0 proposal is therefore covered by both families and the split is recorded in conflicts. No other proposals are merged (rule 7): MatrixVectorHelpers, PackedShortVectorRecord, SparseConstraintSolver, CollisionPrimitives, PhysicsFrameTransform and EmbeddedArrayBlock each map one-to-one to their source proposal. All trust is DERIVED/GUESS; contradictions are recorded in conflicts, not erased.

engine_subsystems.name: MathAndCollision
engine_subsystems.responsibility: Stateless geometry/vector math primitives (ray-sphere quadratic contact, 2D direction projection, SSE two-point interpolation, 3x3 matrix-vector multiply, Euler-to-matrix), a collision-geometry container owning strut and struct arrays with nearest-neighbor queries and teardown, spatial node-chain/tree nearest-neighbor queries feeding AI steering, compressed short-int vector codecs, per-frame vehicle physics frame-transform setup, an embedded-array zero-init helper, and two standalone global-workspace sparse-matrix LDLT constraint solvers. Reconciles the two validated math_and_collision proposals into one subsystem; the container query 0x004038E0 is assigned to CollisionModel (see conflicts).

canonical_type_families.name: CollisionPrimitives
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Stateless geometric/vector math primitives: ray-sphere quadratic intersection (suspension contact, 0x00401180), 2D direction projection (0x00423AD0), SSE two-point linear interpolation (0x0051F6A0). No instance fields, no callees; grouped by shape only - owner identity not proven by the packet.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Boundary clues only, not an instance layout: the +0x0/+0x8 samples are the vector argument layout read by 0x00423AD0 (x at +0x0, z at +0x8), not fields of a shared class object. Stateless helper group; no field ownership claimed.

canonical_type_families.name: CollisionModel
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Collision-geometry container object owning the strut/element array (count +0x130, base +0x134, 316-byte stride), the struct array (+0x154), and further owned buffers (+0x150/+0x158). Hosts nearest-neighbor queries over linked nodes and the strut array (0x00403640, and 0x004038E0 merged here from the SpatialNearestNeighborQuery proposal on identical +0x130/+0x134 stride-316 evidence), an indexed struct read (0x00403F70), and a destructor-style teardown freeing every owned allocation (0x004045F0). Name is descriptive; packet reports owner UNKNOWN.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Boundary clues only. +0x130/+0x134 form a count/base pair for a 316-byte-stride element (strut) array; +0x150/+0x154/+0x158 are owned pointers freed by teardown 0x004045F0; +0x138 reset to 0 and +0x148 -1.0f written during teardown with live roles unknown. The 316-byte element struct and buffer element types are undefined. Full layout not claimed.

canonical_type_families.name: SparseConstraintSolver
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Standalone numeric kernels: block LDL^T factorization and substitution solve of sparse dynamics constraint matrices stored in global double workspaces (0x008CFBF0..0x008D3B60 and 0x008D2120..0x008D3978) indexed by global row-pointer arrays. No parameters, no callees, returns 0. Two independent functions grouped by shared algorithm and overlapping global workspace region.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: No instance fields; operates entirely on global double workspaces and row-pointer tables. Element/layout policy governed by compatibility contract SparseConstraintSolverWorkspace; global buffers must remain byte-compatible.

canonical_type_families.name: SpatialNearestNeighborQuery
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Nearest-neighbor lookups over linked physics-node chains (0x004039C0, BVH-style walk with path-length bound) and spatial trees (0x00403AA0, sibling/child chain walk with fallback to 0x004038E0), used by AI steering / racing-line code. The nearest-strut query 0x004038E0 was split to CollisionModel because it reads the container's +0x130/+0x134 stride-316 array; common ownership of the remaining two methods is unproven.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Boundary clues only. Query-position samples (+0x0/+0x4/+0x8) come from 0x004039C0; node link/path-length concepts (+60, +268, +272, +300) are DERIVED prose, not field-evidenced. 0x00403AA0's own this-field usage is not evidenced by packet operations.

canonical_type_families.name: MatrixVectorHelpers
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Pure matrix/vector math: 3x3 matrix by 3-vector multiply on doubles (0x00435E00) and Euler-angle to row-major 3x3 rotation-matrix conversion on floats (0x00566E40). The shared offsets may hold different element widths; grouping is a DERIVED proposal, not proven common storage.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Boundary clues only, function-local: 0x00435E00 reads 8-byte doubles at 8-byte stride while 0x00566E40 writes 4-byte floats at 4-byte stride over the same nominal offsets 0x0..0x20. Shared storage is unproven (see conflicts); do not build a merged matrix layout on these.

canonical_type_families.name: PackedShortVectorRecord
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Compressed int16 vector codecs: unpack compact records into float vectors with documented scale factors (1/2048 via 0x004B2420, 0.02 via 0x004B2580, 1/512 via 0x004B2800) on the per-frame physics and audio paths. The three methods read different record layouts; grouping is DERIVED and common ownership of one record struct is unproven.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Boundary clues only: three distinct record layouts under one nominal base - 3 raw dwords + 3 int16 (+0x0..+0x10), this[15..17] int16 (+0x1E/+0x20/+0x22), and a 2-component int16 (+0x28/+0x2A). Scale constants read via globals flt_59E77C / flt_59E6EC / flt_59E4D8. Do not assume a single shared record struct.

canonical_type_families.name: PhysicsFrameTransform
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Per-frame vehicle physics transform setup (0x004F17D0): copy a 3x3 rotation matrix and an input 3-vector into a frame buffer at base+0x34B0, compute and store their matrix-by-vector product, return a pointer to the stored matrix. Called per frame from VehiclePhysicsTimeStep.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Boundary clues only: frame buffer region base+0x34B0..+0x3548 holds the rotation matrix (+0x34B0..+0x34D0), input vector (+0x3534..+0x353C) and product (+0x3540..+0x3548), all floats. The role of the output vector within the physics step is not described by the packet.

canonical_type_families.name: EmbeddedArrayBlock
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Zero-init helper (0x004F2B10) clearing a 16-dword (0x40-byte) embedded array block this[0]..this[15] and returning this; used to initialize embedded 16-element arrays inside larger construction objects (physics defaults, tire model data).
canonical_type_families.field_policy: Boundary clues only: 16 dwords at +0x0..+0x3C, write-only. Describes a reusable embedded block, not a top-level type; the enclosing object layouts are outside the packet.

interfaces.name: ISpatialQuery
interfaces.purpose: Nearest-node / nearest-strut / tree spatial lookup used by AI steering and racing-line code, with optional strut-type filtering and plane-side rejection. Covers the three query methods; 0x004038E0 is typed into CollisionModel, the container query role, while 0x004039C0/0x00403AA0 walk node chains/trees.

interfaces.name: ICompressedVectorCodec
interfaces.purpose: Decode compact int16-packed position/direction records into float vectors on the per-frame physics and audio paths, with documented scale factors.

compatibility_contracts.name: SuspensionRaySphereContact
compatibility_contracts.description: Ray-sphere quadratic intersection used by the vehicle suspension force calculation: takes six doubles, returns 0.0 on any miss and 1/sqrt(p) as a penetration-length proxy on hit. Must remain a pure scalar float-returning function with no side effects or callees.

compatibility_contracts.name: CollisionModelOwnedBufferLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: The collision container owns pointer buffers at +0x150/+0x154/+0x158 and a 316-byte-stride element array at +0x134 (count +0x130) whose allocation is length-prefixed 4 bytes before the base. Teardown frees each non-null buffer via FreeWrapper_7bcf, runs per-element release (0x004B0170) over the element array, frees the array allocation, nulls the pointers, writes -1.0f at +0x148, clears +0x130/+0x134/+0x138, and returns the prior array base.

compatibility_contracts.name: NearestNeighborQueryResult
compatibility_contracts.description: Nearest-neighbor query walks linked collision nodes (next pointers at +0x110/+0x10C) and the strut array (316-byte stride, entries with type field at +0x12C <= 1 distance-tested), using a signed plane-distance probe (0x004FB6D0). Returns a node pointer, preferring the plane-verified candidate when its final signed distance is non-negative.

compatibility_contracts.name: SparseConstraintSolverWorkspace
compatibility_contracts.description: Two standalone LDLT solvers factor global double constraint-matrix workspaces (0x008CFBF0..0x008D3B60 and 0x008D2120..0x008D3978) indexed by global row-pointer arrays (0x008D3988..0x008D3A24 and 0x008D3B68..0x008D3BF0); both take no parameters and return 0. A replacement must keep these global buffers and pointer tables byte-compatible.

compatibility_contracts.name: NearestNeighborQuerySemantics
compatibility_contracts.description: Nearest-neighbor lookups must preserve the documented selection rules: zero-count early return (strut count at base+0x130 <= 0), strut-type filter (a3 == -1 or equals element type at +300), plane-side rejection selecting the linked +272 child, and the 200.0 accumulated path-length bound for chain traversal.

compatibility_contracts.name: ShortVectorPackingScale
compatibility_contracts.description: Compressed int16 vectors must decode with the packet's documented scale factors: 1/2048 for the 3-dword + 3-int16 record, 0.02 for the this[15..17] record, and 1/512 for the 2-component this[20]/this[21] record with the Y output component zeroed.

compatibility_contracts.name: MatrixVectorMultiplyReturnsInput
compatibility_contracts.description: The 3x3-by-vector multiply must return the input vector pointer; the Euler conversion must produce a row-major 3x3 rotation matrix with no side effects; MatrixVectorSetup must return a pointer to the stored matrix.

conflicts.subject: Strut-array container identity across proposals: CollisionModel (+0x130/+0x134) vs SpatialNearestNeighborQuery (0x004038E0)
alternatives: math_and_collision_01 CollisionModel owns the +0x130/+0x134 316-byte-stride element array; teardown 0x004045F0 frees it
wave_001_math_and_collision_01 SpatialNearestNeighborQuery 0x004038E0 reads the identical +0x130/+0x134 316-byte-stride array
conflicts.resolution: Same count/base pair with the same unusual 316-byte stride, plus ownership teardown in 0x004045F0, support one container. This candidate assigns 0x004038E0 to CollisionModel and keeps the node-chain/tree walkers (0x004039C0, 0x00403AA0) separate because they read different structures (query position +0/4/8, node links). A third independent witness (live poke of the array base/count, or a shared field table) is required to promote this above DERIVED.

conflicts.subject: SpatialNearestNeighborQuery grouping: three query methods vs one loose family
alternatives: wave_001_math_and_collision_01 keeps 0x004038E0/0x004039C0/0x00403AA0 together (proposal view, common ownership unproven)
this candidate splits 0x004038E0 into CollisionModel on the container evidence and keeps 0x004039C0/0x00403AA0 in SpatialNearestNeighborQuery
conflicts.resolution: The proposal itself states common ownership of the query fields is not proven. Container evidence (+0x130/+0x134 stride 316 owned by CollisionModel) outweighs shape similarity; split recorded here so the comparison phase can weigh it against candidates that keep all three together.

conflicts.subject: MatrixVectorHelpers element width at shared offsets 0x0..0x20
alternatives: 0x00435E00 reads 8-byte doubles at 8-byte stride over this+0x0..0x40
0x00566E40 writes 4-byte floats at 4-byte stride over this+0x0..0x20
conflicts.resolution: The nominal offsets overlap but the element widths differ; the two functions may be reading distinct storage that merely shares offsets. Not resolvable from the packet; the family is kept as a DERIVED proposal with function-local field_policy, not a merged layout.

conflicts.subject: PackedShortVectorRecord single-struct ownership
alternatives: One record struct accessed at different field ranges (+0x0..0x10, +0x1E..0x22, +0x28..0x2A)
Three independent record layouts grouped only by the int16-vector codec pattern
conflicts.resolution: Each method reads a distinct layout with a different documented scale; common ownership of one struct is unproven. Kept as one DERIVED family with a per-layout field_policy; a caller-side struct definition would be required to confirm.

conflicts.subject: SparseConstraintSolver: two phases, two instances, or two kernels
alternatives: Two phases of one solver sharing a workspace region (0x008D3A28..0x008D3B60 touched by both)
Two solver instances / two independent kernels on disjoint matrix buffers
conflicts.resolution: Both factor global double matrices and touch the overlapping diagonals/accumulator region 0x008D3A28..0x008D3B60, but operate on disjoint matrix buffers (0x008CFBF0.. vs 0x008D2120..). Not provable from the packet; recorded, not merged into one semantic.

conflicts.subject: CollisionPrimitives grouping by shape only
alternatives: Three stateless math helpers as one class (proposal view)
Three unrelated free functions: 0x00401180 on the suspension path, 0x00423AD0 on an AI/opponent proximity path, 0x0051F6A0 with no callers
conflicts.resolution: Each function has an UNKNOWN owner and no callees; the packet proves no shared class. Grouped as GUESS by shape only; treat as a convenience grouping until owner evidence appears.

The two solver functions share overlapping global workspace regions (0x008D3A28..0x008D3B60 is touched by both) but operate on disjoint matrix buffers; whether they are two phases of one solver, two solver instances, or two independent kernels is not provable from the packet.
